verdict.rationale: Steel provides on-demand cloud browser sessions, a CLI, and integrations that let external agent frameworks drive a browser. The evidence never documents Steel itself offering automations that can be set up to run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled runs, triggers, or hosted recurring jobs. The integrations state that the external SDK or framework runs the agent loop and orchestration while Steel only supplies the browser, so these are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.
